cocktails.name: Ramos Fizz
cocktails.glass: strain into a highball glass, top up with soda.
cocktails.instructions:
Pour all ingredients except soda water in a cocktail shaker with ice.
Shake for two minutes, double strain in a glass, pour the drink back in the shaker and hard shake without ice for one minute.
Strain into a highball glass, top up with soda.
NOTE: The drink was invented by Henry Ramos in 1888, at his bar Meyer’s Table d’Hôtel Internationale in New Orleans. The Ramos Fizz was originally shaken for 12 minutes by a crew of 30 bartenders who passed the shaker from one to another.

iba::sherry_cobbler.instructions: Combine sherry, sugar and 2 quarter wheels each of orange and lemon in a shaker with ice, shake briskly, strain into a Julep cocktail cup filled with crushed ice.
iba::sherry_cobbler.garnish: Garnish with fresh berries, ¼ wheel each orange and lemon. Serve with straws.

iba::negroni.name: Negroni
iba::negroni.instructions: Pour all ingredients directly into chilled old fashioned glass filled with ice.\nStir gently.
iba::negroni.glass: pour all ingredients directly into chilled old fashioned glass filled with ice.

iba::mint_julep.name: Mint Julep
iba::mint_julep.instructions: In Julep Stainless Steel Cup gently muddle the mint with sugar and water.\nFill the glass with cracked ice, add the Bourbon and stir well until the cup frosts.
iba::mint_julep.glass: fill the glass with cracked ice, add the bourbon and stir well until the cup frosts.

iba::paper_plane.name: Paper Plane
iba::paper_plane.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.
iba::paper_plane.glass: pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

iba::planters_punch.name: Planters Punch
iba::planters_punch.instructions: Pour all ingredients directly in a small tumbler or a typical terracotta glass.\nNOTE: Add dilution up to taste, it can be given by water, ice or fresh juices.
iba::planters_punch.glass: pour all ingredients directly in a small tumbler or a typical terracotta glass.

iba::south_side.name: South Side
iba::south_side.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, double-strain into chilled cocktail glass.\nNote: If egg white is used shake vigorously.
iba::south_side.glass: pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, double-strain into chilled cocktail glass.
